title: A Tensor Neural Network Method for High-Order Homogenization of Locally Periodic Elliptic Problems
summary: We develop a high-order tensor neural network (TNN) method for locally periodic elliptic multiscale problems of the form $-\nabla\cdot(A(x,x/\varepsilon)\nabla u_\varepsilon)=f$. Because the coefficient depends on both the slow variable $x$ and the fast periodic variable $y=x/\varepsilon$, the high-order cell problems and macroscopic corrector equations are more involved than in the classical case $A=A(y)$, and the correctors depend parametrically on $x$.
